address: Royal Botanic Gardens, Kew, Richmond, Surrey,TW9 3AE
bio: Enjoy an Afternoon Tea overlooking the lush landscapes of Kew Gardens.  Featuring diverse plant life from around the world, iconic architecture and impressive landscapes. Kew Gardens is the nature lovers ideal location for Afternoon Tea.  Afternoon Tea is served Afternoon Tea is served in The Botanical restaurant, boasting beautiful views of the Pond and the exotic Palm House.  Diners have a choice of Traditional, Vegetarian or Gardener's Afternoon Tea, all featuring sandwiches, savoury bites, scones with clotted cream and jam, pastries and of course a choice of teas.  Kew Gardens is a UNESCO World Heritage Site located in Southwest London. The closest stations are Kew Gardens Station or Kew Bridge Station.
